caption: The first screen, HOME: PLAY NOW in orange with ROOKIE lit under it, then SEASON, MODES and PLAY WITH A FRIEND; on the right ONE MATCH and what the two mouse buttons do with and without the puck.

The opening faceoff of PLAY NOW at rookie: the card MATCH 1 / PERIOD 1 - FACEOFF - ROOKIE, you (number 7, marked YOU) over the dot against the orange centre, the drop ring at 1 HOLD, the timber stands full.
Your body check takes an orange skater off his skates: he hangs upside down above his own shadow, stick in the air (PLAY NOW, rookie, period 2, 1 : 0). Only the figures: nothing is drawn on the ice.
GOAL, 1 : 0: a mate finishes a breakaway in period 1 (PLAY NOW, rookie); you raise a fist, he raises both arms, the lamp behind the net is lit and the stands are on their feet.

Many games in one: Glow Ice, one of the twelve modes. The dark sheet drawn in lines of light, your goal for 1 : 0 (first to 4, rookie), the burst of light over the net, both arms up, the puck glowing in the crease.

A held cross-check seen from behind: the stick level across your shoulders as you skate into the play (PLAY NOW, rookie, period 2). The panel reads WITHOUT THE PUCK: LMB CROSS-CHECK, RMB CHECK, SPACE POKE.

The controls panel in play: WITH THE PUCK: LMB SHOOT, RMB PASS, WHEEL DEKE, E SPIN, and under it SKATE, SPRINT, BRAKE. In front of the orange net with your stick up, the puck a stride away and the goalie down in his crease; it is 3 : 0 half a second later (rookie, period 3).
Fog of War: three a side on night ice under pools of light, the far boards and the stands lost in mist; you carry the puck over the centre line with an orange skater at your shoulder (rookie, 0 : 0).
Pond: daylight, open stands and pines beyond the boards, a clock instead of first-to-three (2:58 on it). Five a side; you carry at the orange net, and the RMB PASS row of the panel is lit.
The end card: YOU WIN, YOU 3 : 0 THEM; SHOTS 3, GOALS 2, PASSES THAT ARRIVED 4 OF 14, HITS LANDED 13, WITH THE PUCK 0:25; R / VIEW REMATCH, ESC / START MENU.
quote: The booth: "A clean sheet. Not a thing got through."

caption: A scramble at the orange net: your check puts a defender on his back in his own crease, a second one behind him, the puck loose at their skates and the crowd right above (PLAY NOW, rookie, period 2, 1 : 0).
The best single frame: your cross-check has just landed, orange number 9 is level with the ice in mid-air, your stick still high (PLAY NOW, rookie, period 2).
